## Goal

Create bounded failure diagnostics, durable incomplete-work state, single-flight monitoring, and production resource/circuit-breaker enforcement while proving the helper boundary feasibility.

## Deliverables

- Safe-start and resource enforcement
- Bounded diagnostic harness
- Tests and evidence

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-301-01` — Monitoring work is single-flight and abnormal interruption becomes explicit stale/degraded state rather than an automatic dangerous restart.
- `AC-301-02` — Resource measurements activate backpressure and a circuit breaker before an uncontrolled scan can continue.
- `AC-301-03` — A bounded fixture harness captures work, memory, CPU, database, WAL, and queue evidence without scanning the user's live roots.

- `EV-301-01` (tests-and-traces) — Focused containment tests and bounded diagnostic output.
